sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module is designed to: Introduce students to the craft of storytelling including basic building blocks of character creation, intention, conflict etc. Provide a historical context for stories and myths from diverse cultures Engage students in the art of storytelling Promote the rules of storytelling and allow the generation of original stories
sections.Learning outcomes: A.Understand mythic structures and how they permeate film and TV stories B.Comprehend the significance of character arc and character development, conflict (inner and externalized); and how this can be conveyed to an audience C.Engage in the practical task of writing an original narrative story
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components (Lectures and seminars). A series of lectures will provide the historical and conceptual background to understand the writer and his/her process Seminars will focus on the practical process of ideas generation and writing exercises.
